hall.name: Town Hall
hall.note: 6 rations attract a new peasant every 30 seconds; up to 12 residents.

farm.name: Farm
farm.note: Grows rations. Route them to the Town Hall and schools.

lumber.name: Lumber Camp
lumber.note: Produces timber. Collect some in your backpack to build.

mine.name: Iron Mine
mine.note: Must touch an iron deposit. Produces iron ore.

kiln.name: Charcoal Kiln
kiln.note: Burns timber into charcoal for smelting.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.note: Choose one recipe per smithy. Add parallel smithies for continuous production.

barn.name: Warehouse Barn
barn.note: Local storage only. Deliveries need roads and routes.

sword_school.name: Sword School
sword_school.note: Teaches Sword using 1 sword and 2 rations. Recruit walks here by road.

shield_school.name: Shield School
shield_school.note: Teaches Shield. A Sword + Shield recruit becomes a Man-at-Arms.
